items.title: A STANDING.md plugin so my agent stops guessing — excerpt 1
items.detail:
The author reports limitations with retaining this instruction in memory.

My agent keeps confidently guessing instead of checking its own docs. I put 'always verify first' in memory but it has a hard char limit and entries get compressed/replaced over time. Fix: a tiny plugin that reads a STANDING.md file and injects it into the system prompt every turn via pre_llm_call.

— @jezza2463, 2026-04-03, via Discord.
items.author: @jezza2463

items.title: The anatomy of the ~/.hermes folder — one folder controls everything — excerpt 1
items.summary: what did we discuss three weeks ago?
items.detail:
Author-provided example wording; not a verified success claim.

One folder controls everything your hermes agent knows, remembers, and can do. SOUL.md occupies slot #1 in the system prompt. state.db with FTS5 is what makes 'what did we discuss three weeks ago?' actually work across CLI and messaging.

— @akshay_pachaar, 2026-05-16, via X · Twitter.

items.title: Telegram assistant recalled Japan-trip preferences while planning a France trip — excerpt 1
items.summary: help me plan a trip to France
items.detail:
The author reports using this wording; see the original story for the outcome.

In a new Telegram conversation I said 'help me plan a trip to France' and the agent referenced the past Japan conversation, recalling my preferences — nature, history, mid-range budget. That's the difference between a chatbot and a personal assistant.

— Vivek Shetye (YouTube), 2026-05-04, via YouTube.
